content.text: No auto-renewal mechanic exists; maintenance runs on a renewable one-year term with no notice window or lock-in.

input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: Maintenance runs for a "renewable one-year term" (§10, p0065) with no automatic renewal language anywhere in the Agreement — renewal therefore requires the parties' agreement, which matches the preferred position (renewal only by mutual written agreement, 12-month periods). There is no non-renewal notice window to compute and no multi-year auto-renewal, so no walk-away or fallback issue arises; exit is further protected because the licence is perpetual while fees are paid and Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice (§17(a)-(b)). Note only as a sub-element: the Fee Schedule mechanics (§11) contain no cap on maintenance fee uplift at renewal (preferred is the lesser of CPI and 3%); consistent with the playbook, a missing price-uplift cap is noted rather than flagged, and we can raise it commercially if the Fee Schedule permits unilateral increases.
